verdict.rationale: Zep is an API-based SaaS memory service, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. The only hint is a 'v3' segment in a docs URL (zep-docs-43), and that page's content is about migrating from Mem0, not about API versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
